class Matcher:
    def __init__(self, rules):  # rules list of (rid,cls,prio,ranges)
        self.rules=rules
        n=len(rules)
        self.k=[len(r[3]) for r in rules]
        self.rid=[r[0] for r in rules]
        self.cls=[r[1] for r in rules]
        self.prio=[r[2] for r in rules]
        base=0
        self.base=[]
        self.term_bit=[]
        START=0; TERM=0
        P=0
        for idx,r in enumerate(rules):
            k=len(r[3])
            self.base.append(base)
            tb=base+k-1
            self.term_bit.append(tb)
            START |= (1<<base)
            TERM |= (1<<tb)
            base += k+1
        self.P=base
        self.START=START; self.TERM=TERM
        # term bit -> rule idx
        tbmap={}
        for idx,tb in enumerate(self.term_bit): tbmap[tb]=idx
        self.tbmap=tbmap
        # build B over values [-2048,2048]
        V=4097; OFF=2048
        add_at=[[] for _ in range(V+1)]
        rem_at=[[] for _ in range(V+1)]
        for idx,r in enumerate(rules):
            b=self.base[idx]
            for i,(lo,hi) in enumerate(r[3]):
                p=b+i
                alo=lo+OFF
                if alo<0: alo=0
                ahi=hi+OFF
                if ahi>V-1: ahi=V-1
                if alo<=ahi:
                    add_at[alo].append(p)
                    if ahi+1<=V-1:
                        rem_at[ahi+1].append(p)
        B=[0]*V
        cur=0
        for v in range(V):
            for p in add_at[v]: cur |= (1<<p)
            for p in rem_at[v]: cur ^= (1<<p)
            B[v]=cur
        self.B=B
        self.OFF=OFF
        self.maxlen=max(self.k) if self.k else 0
    def step(self,D,v):
        return ((D<<1)|self.START) & self.B[v+self.OFF]
